audience: training and marketing teams that make avatar videos in Synthesia

useCases.title: Find a template and its variables
useCases.text: List the workspace templates with their variables, so you know what to fill in.

useCases.title: Check the status of recent videos
useCases.text: List the latest videos with their status, then read one video for its download link once it is complete.

useCases.title: Render a one-scene test video
useCases.text: Create a test video with one scene, an avatar id and a background id. Test videos do not count against quota.

useCases.title: Start a video from scenes
useCases.text: Start a render from one or more scenes, each with a script, an avatar id and a background id. Then poll the video until it is complete.
